simple.meaning: כָּאַב (kâʼab) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship. The surrounding account also brings the name into death.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, 2 Kings, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 34:25. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, death, righteousness, kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כָּאַב (H3510) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows כָּאַב through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: כָּאַב (kâʼab) / H3510 is tracked through Genesis 34:25, 2 Kings 3:19, Job 5:18, Job 14:22. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
